label: Boer War conclusion after the 1901 conjunction

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: The 1901 Jupiter-Saturn conjunction was followed after some months by the conclusion of the Boer War, with Venus on the ninth cusp at London.

label: Collapse of France shown in the United Kingdom national chart

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: The collapse of France in 1940 was shown in the United Kingdom 1801 national map by progressed Moon conjunct Saturn in the eleventh house.

label: Hitler overtures and temporary peace signal in the 1940 conjunction series

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: The first 1940-41 conjunction figure showed Venus almost precisely rising at London, which led Carter to think peace must be at hand, and he connects it with Hitler's overtures and relative peace in Britain compared with invasion.

notes: Diplomacy benchmark for overture or temporary de-escalation signals inside an ongoing conflict, not for a formal treaty outcome.

label: Tientsin treaty-port blockade and coerced settlement of 1939

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: The 1939 Aries Ingress for London timed the Tienstin Incident, when Japan blockaded the British concessions on 14 June 1939 and Britain ended the blockade by handing over the four Chinese fugitives on 20 August 1939; the involvement of the Sun, Mars, and the 6th and 9th houses is evident in this international incident.

notes: Second-source diplomacy case for treaty-port coercion and foreign-affairs failure rather than peaceful settlement.
